candidates.change_summary: Replace return $._owner with return address(0) to always return zero address, changing the observable owner value.
Replace return $._owner with return _msgSender() to return the caller instead of the actual owner.
Replace `return $._paused;` with `return !$._paused;` to invert the paused state.
Replace the hardcoded default royaltyBPS 500 with 0, causing getRoyalties to return zero royalty BPS for tokens without an explicit config.
Replace the default royaltyRecipient with address(0) in the final return, changing the receiver address for tokens without an explicit config.
Replace the early return condition with if (config.royaltyBPS > 0), so even tokens with a non-zero royalty recipient fall through to the default config unless BPS is also set.
Replace the fallback return with return config; after the NOT_INITIALIZED check, so a token with no explicit config gets the zeroed-out RoyaltyConfiguration instead of the global default.
Delete the early return when a token-specific config exists, so even tokens with a stored config always fall through to the hardcoded default.
